create_materials_default: create a Materials instance with default white ambient, diffuse, and specular colors and shininess 64
create_materials_custom_colors: create a Materials instance with custom RGB ambient, diffuse, and specular color tuples and a shininess value
create_materials_batch: create a batch of N Materials with per-element ambient, diffuse, specular colors and shininess values
clone_materials: clone an existing Materials instance to create an independent copy with the same material properties
review_materials_validation: review the Materials class constructor validation logic for color channel consistency and shininess shape checks
